summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The Pacer Swan SOS Moderate September ETF (MSEP) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in downside hedge alternatives. The fund aims to buffer the first 15% of losses and cap upside gains of the SPDR S&P 500 ETF (SPY) over a specific holding period. The actively managed fund holds options and collateral. MSEP was launched on Jun 11, 2026 and is issued by Pacer.
